visualCharacteristics.purpose: Cruise search panel with select boxes (cruise type, region, date, passengers) and a Search button that sends the choices to a results page

contentPattern.structure: Optional action row: a single link (text = button label, href = results page). Then one row per select: 1) field label (also the empty first option); 2) bulleted list of options; a bold item is preselected, "Label|value" sets an explicit value

reuseGuidance: Use under the landing hero. Option lists are authored; the block does not load live availability.
